mapper.update: update tb_general_setting set setting_value = #{settingValue} where setting_name =#{settingName}
mapper.select: select id , warning_grade as warningGrade from tb_early_warning where node_id =#{nodeId} and is_affirm = 2;
select id , warning_grade as warningGrade from tb_early_warning where node_id =#{stackId} and is_affirm = 2 and node_id is null;
select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = #{settingKey}
select node_id,warning_grade from tb_general_setting where is_affirm = 0 order by warning_grade desc;

select warning_type as warningType, warning_grade as warningGrade, COUNT(warning_grade='1' OR NULL) AS oneWarningCount, COUNT(warning_grade='2' OR NULL) AS twoWarningCount, COUNT(warning_grade='3' OR NULL) AS threeWarningCount from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal_name = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} <= (CASE warning_grade WHEN '1' THEN warning_time_one WHEN '2' THEN warning_time_two WHEN '3' THEN warning_time_three END) and #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} >= (CASE warning_grade WHEN '1' THEN warning_time_one WHEN '2' THEN warning_time_two WHEN '3' THEN warning_time_three END) group by warning_type,warning_grade

SELECT stack_id AS stackId, is_affirm AS affirm, warning_grade AS warningGrade, substring_index(group_concat(node_type),',',1) AS nodeType, (CASE warning_grade WHEN '1' THEN substring_index(group_concat(warning_val_one),',',1) WHEN '2' THEN substring_index(group_concat(warning_val_two),',',1) WHEN '3' THEN substring_index(group_concat(warning_val_three),',',1) END) AS warningVal, (CASE warning_grade WHEN '1' THEN substring_index(group_concat(warning_time_one),',',1) WHEN '2' THEN substring_index(group_concat(warning_time_two),',',1) WHEN '3' THEN substring_index(group_concat(warning_time_three),',',1) END) AS warningTime FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal_name = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} <= (CASE warning_grade WHEN '1' THEN warning_time_one WHEN '2' THEN warning_time_two WHEN '3' THEN warning_time_three END) and #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} >= (CASE warning_grade WHEN '1' THEN warning_time_one WHEN '2' THEN warning_time_two WHEN '3' THEN warning_time_three END) GROUP BY is_affirm,warning_grade,stack_id ORDER BY is_affirm DESC,warning_grade DESC;

select id, warning_type warningType , node_id nodeId , node_type nodeType , warning_val_one warningValOne , warning_time_one warningTimeOne , warning_val_two warningValTwo , warning_time_two warningTimeTwo , warning_val_three warningValThree , warning_time_three warningTimeThree , warning_grade warningGrade , stack_id stackId from tb_early_warning where stack_id = #{stackId} and is_affirm = 0 ;
select count (*) from tb_early_warning where node_id = #{nodeId} and status = 2 and warning_type = #{warningType}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_early_warning ( warning_type, node_id, node_type, warning_val_one, warning_time_one, warning_val_two, warning_time_two, warning_val_three, warning_time_three, warning_grade, stack_id, area_id, is_affirm ) values { #{earlyWarning.warningType} #{earlyWarning.nodeId}, #{earlyWarning.nodeType}, #{earlyWarning.warningValOne}, #{earlyWarning.warningTimeOne}, #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo}, #{earlyWarning.warningTimeTwo}, #{earlyWarning.warningValThree}, #{earlyWarning.warningTimeThree}, #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, #{earlyWarning.stackId}, #{earlyWarning.areaId}, 2 }
mapper.update: update tb_early_warning set warning_grade = #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, warning_val_two = #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo}, warning_val_three = #{earlyWarning.warningValThree}, warning_time_two = sysdate() warning_time_three = sysdate() where id = #{earlyWarning.id}
